items.title: Two sequences of insertions of the same length give Knuth equivalent matchings
items.author: Avichai Marmor
items.work: Schur-positivity of short chords in matchings
items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled lemma at source lines 1179-1182: for a matching m and two sequences i_1,...,i_k and j_1,...,j_k of insertion positions, the two iterated insertions give Knuth equivalent matchings. The proof (source lines 1184-1188) is an induction on k whose step has to combine the two earlier insertion lemmas in the right order: the induction hypothesis is applied to the tails of the two sequences, and an insertion position has to be moved into place before the preservation result can be used, which is exactly the content of the preceding lemma; the statement records only the conclusion of the iteration and none of this bookkeeping.
